name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.5 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 16 times in 4 visits over 31 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 32 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 31 hours starting 2026-05-20, at wavelengths from 1.24 to 4.91 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
